case_name: Ga Arife @ Arti Sharma vs Gopal Dutt Sharma
facts_of_case: Appellant challenged orders of Courts below. Appellant sought divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Appellant claimed conversion from Islam to Hinduism to lawfully marry respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to introduce a new plea to prove it with documentary evidence.
legal_principles.held: Counsel for the respondent further argued that no documentary evidence was placed on record by the appellant to prove that she got converted to Hinduism and similarly no documentary evidence was produced to establish the factum of marriage.
cited_cases: Gullipilli Sowria Raj vs Bandaru Pavani alias Gullipilli Pavani (2009) 1 SCC 714

legal_principles.principle: A party's inconsistent stands can be considered by the court while evaluating their case.
legal_principles.held: Counsel submitted that in the legal notice dated 9th June, 1989 proved on record as exhibit PW 1/D-9 the appellant took a stand that her marriage with the respondent took place at D-212, Pragati Vihar Hostel, New Delhi and similarly in the petition filed under Section 125 Cr.P.C., Ex. PW1/D-1, the same place of marriage was disclosed by the appellant.

outcome.final_order: This common order shall dispose MAT Appeal Nos. 69/2010 and 70/2010 preferred by the appellant challenging the orders of the Courts below.
